column4: Guard cleat#4340: a cancel, a terminate and a cooperative cancel addressed to a continue-as-new chain act on its current run, a pending cooperative cancel is carried to the successor, a race lands exactly once and leaves no open successor. registeredBackends tests, so each runs one subtest per dialect (6 tests, 2 arms each) and mysql and mssql skip in this PostgreSQL-only job.
